player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Ũtaarĩirie kĩhumo kana mũthingi ũtarĩ wa gwĩkwo.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Nĩ wageririe kũruta ndemwa ĩyo kuuma nyũmba-inĩ ya igũrũ ĩtarĩ na kĩndũ.
invalid_move.same_tower: Nĩ wageririe gũthamia ndemwa ĩyo thĩinĩ wa nyũmba o ta ĩrĩa.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Nĩ wageririe kũiga ndemwa nene igũrũ rĩa ndemwa nini.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You solved the Tower of Hanoi puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: Mũhaka wa kũgarũrũka nĩ ũhingio. Ũigĩte {pct}% ya ndeki wega thĩinĩ wa C Tower.
